crewNotes.text: These are the general US traveller allowances; operating crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with CBP. Compiled from the cited CBP guidance and pending final authority review.

rules.text: Travellers aged 21 or over may include one US litre (33.8 fl oz) of alcoholic beverages in the personal exemption, for personal use.
Currency or monetary instruments of USD 10,000 or more (or the foreign equivalent) carried into or out of the United States must be reported to CBP (FinCEN Form 105).

declarationRequirements.text: The standard duty-free personal exemption for returning US residents is USD 800; visiting non-residents receive a smaller exemption. Goods above the exemption must be declared to CBP.

rules.text: The personal exemption includes up to 200 cigarettes and 100 cigars when arriving from a non-beneficiary country.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
